create_CopelandVoting: create a CopelandVoting instance to run an election using Copeland's method
run_CopelandVoting_election: run an election with CopelandVoting given a PreferenceProfile and return a RankOutcome
get_CopelandVoting_name: get the name string of a CopelandVoting voting method instance
build_PreferenceProfile: build a PreferenceProfile from a list of votes and alternatives for use with CopelandVoting
validate_PreferenceProfile: validate a PreferenceProfile to ensure it has at least one vote and one alternative
